purpose: Unified provenance headers for portfolio Evaluation (Batch C). Numbers on /eval are copied from these reports — do not invent latency/cost.

dataset.name: golden_apr_jul_2026
dataset.keep_definition: DERIVED: keep = (overall >= 75.0), see data/eval/relabel/keep_provenance_v2.json — not an independent human selection
dataset.label_origin: Qwen-VL relabel pass + human review; only the 30% blind subset in data/eval/relabel/blind_split.json is AI-independent
dataset.preferences: data/eval/preferences/pairs.jsonl (derived from golden_core — OLD SCALE, not regenerated)

dataset_history.note: golden_core labels/manifest/predictions/stage2 rows are archived there; its 258 preview JPEGs were deleted and are regenerable via scripts/eval/sample_eval_set.py. Original labels also live in git at commit ca85826.
dataset_history.scale_warning: The relabel pass removed a ~22.6-point floor the old prompt added to every frame, so golden_core scores and golden_apr_jul_2026 scores are NOT on the same scale. Any report tagged dataset=golden_core below cannot be compared numerically against a run on the current set — re-run on the current set to compare.

reports.note: Computed on golden_core, which no longer exists as a live dataset. MAE in particular is scale-dependent and is meaningless against the current labels.

Production gating replay — not a second GPU pass. Gated Spearman is on the 16 admitted images only. Computed on golden_core; tests/test_eval_two_stage_gating.py now skips until a pipeline run exists over the current data/eval/images/.

Diagnosis of the golden_core 0.362 figure: Pearson 0.84 was carried by ~11 extreme trash images, mid-band rank agreement ≈0.29. The coarse-label problem it describes is what the current relabel pass set out to fix.

gaps.note: No stage3 run exists yet on golden_apr_jul_2026. Until one does, there is no baseline the current dataset can be compared against — every headline number above predates it.

golden_core was the only set with AI-independent human labels and has been retired. The current set's non-blind labels all originate from Qwen-VL, so agreement metrics against it are partly self-referential. The 30% blind subset is the only clean signal.
